title: 有馬記念の後に・見渡せば

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature wins the Arima Kinen and attributes her success in the tough race to the support of her fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She then tries to ask Mejiro McQueen and Mejiro Ryan the secret to becoming even stronger than she is now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two promise to answer this question properly at a later time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Showing signs of new growth, Nice Nature aims for her next goal—the Takarazuka Kinen.
